body: Closing: superseded. hunch.config.ts and hunch.lock were removed from main (cfedbeddd), and review now runs through JevLint saved checks (docs/review/README.md).

Closing: adds a second @cashu/coco-core patch, against ADR 0017/0019 (Coco ships unmodified apart from the offline-send patch; cocoCoreUnmodified.test.ts). It also fails a SQL round-trip: a custom method is read back as bolt11. It would need upstream Coco support first.
Closing: already on main (fe8a5992f). The README badges were removed later on purpose.

Closing: written against the pre-monorepo layout (412 files). Main shrinks eslint-suppressions.json gradually instead of deleting it in one sweep. Worth redoing as small slices on main: hex colours to tokens, removing explicit any, the new rules. Removing memos needs re-proving under the React Compiler.
Closing: same head branch as #235, which is closed.
Closing: its base branch was never merged, its work is included in #235, and the code it changes has moved since.
Closing: already on main through the merged stack (naggFeedClient uses runNaggRest).
Closing: already on main (merged via #227's stack).
Closing: replaced by #226's maintainVisibleContentPosition approach, which ADR 0004 (thread-list anchoring) settled and is on main.

Closing: 1,900 commits behind main, from before the monorepo move. The fix (a renderable extension on Blossom URLs for extension-sniffing clients such as njump) is still missing on main, so it's recorded in docs/follow-ups to redo on the current app/ paths.
